scope: Independent exact local Git fetches; metadata-only AI co-author removal from both five-commit layers.

commits.subject: fix(cache): normalize origin dispatch and preserve follower bodies

metadata.author: Larry D Almeida
metadata.message:
fix(cache): normalize origin dispatch and preserve follower bodies

Share validated direct-versus-pipeline dispatch for cold misses and refreshes. Preserve transformed paths, outgoing Host and independent follower response bodies; reject Vary wildcard caching and sharing.

Signed-off-by: Larry D Almeida <20266078+larry-dalmeida@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: fix(cache): isolate Vary variants and preserve 304 representations

metadata.author: Larry D Almeida
metadata.message:
fix(cache): isolate Vary variants and preserve 304 representations

Use variant-aware storage for cold misses, response processing and refreshes. Carry base keys through revalidation, enforce all Vary field lines for followers and retain cached bodies while merging conditional responses.

Signed-off-by: Larry D Almeida <20266078+larry-dalmeida@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: fix(cache): retain last-good responses across failed refreshes

metadata.author: Larry D Almeida
metadata.message:
fix(cache): retain last-good responses across failed refreshes

Preserve eligible variants and original SIE timestamps on transport errors, incomplete bodies and HTTP 500/502/503/504, including inner loopback response processing. Recheck eligibility after fetch and skip queued refreshes superseded by newer fresh variants.

Signed-off-by: Larry D Almeida <20266078+larry-dalmeida@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: fix(cache): honor backend phase timeouts for origin fetches

metadata.author: Larry D Almeida
metadata.message:
fix(cache): honor backend phase timeouts for origin fetches

Apply configured dial, TLS, response-header and expect-continue timeouts to the cache-origin transport without imposing a blanket request or body deadline. Cover timeout mapping, stale response preservation and recovery.

Signed-off-by: Larry D Almeida <20266078+larry-dalmeida@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: fix(cache): consult L2 after L1 freshness expires

metadata.author: Larry D Almeida
metadata.message:
fix(cache): consult L2 after L1 freshness expires

Require positive-TTL L1 entries to remain within their freshness deadline before bypassing shared L2. Preserve zero-TTL semantics and stale retention, with freshness boundaries, fresh-L2 precedence, no-origin request regressions and benchmarks.

Signed-off-by: Larry D Almeida <20266078+larry-dalmeida@users.noreply.github.com>

metadata.author: Larry D Almeida
metadata.message:
feat: expose cache occupancy and route outcomes

Expose process L1 occupancy, per-route cache results, and first-hit latency with focused metrics tests and operational guidance.

metadata.author: Larry D Almeida
metadata.message:
feat: measure cache origin fetches and refresh outcomes

Measure cache-owned origin dispatches, bounded Cache-Control directives, and background refresh outcomes without replay double counting; document and exercise transport, storage, and response failures.

metadata.author: Larry D Almeida
metadata.message:
feat: count external clients without cache replay

Count external client arrivals independently of cache replay, propagate authenticated internal-request context, and cover proxy, healthcheck, redirect, and marker boundaries.

metadata.author: Larry D Almeida
metadata.message:
feat: attribute cache reads and L2 operations

Carry cache-read provenance and typed response/metadata purposes through storage, observe client calls separately from serialization failures, and cover forwarding, silent reads, and actual Valkey StorageAPI behavior.

Signed-off-by: Larry D Almeida <20266078+larry-dalmeida@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: feat: record terminal cache decisions by serving tier

metadata.author: Larry D Almeida
metadata.message:
feat: record terminal cache decisions by serving tier

Emit one bounded terminal decision per external cache-filter request, retaining lookup-failure precedence and actual serving-tier provenance across coalescing, stale fallback, and internal replay; document request denominators and verify Prometheus output.
